Config.Title: Folder Permissions: {folder}
Config.Instructions: Set ownership for everything in this folder. "No change" leaves that entry as it is on each document. "Default" makes the player fall back to the All Players level.
Config.NoPlayers: There are no player accounts in this world.
Config.RememberHint: Documents created in, imported into, or moved into this folder (or a subfolder without its own rule) receive these permissions automatically.

Confirm.Title: Apply Folder Permissions
Confirm.Content: This will change the ownership of {documents} document(s) in {folders} folder(s). Continue?

Notify.Cleared: "{folder}" no longer passes its permissions to new contents.
Notify.Inherited: "{folder}" was moved: {documents} document(s) inherited their new parent folder's permissions.

AutoInherit.Name: Automatic inheritance
AutoInherit.Hint: Documents created in or moved into a folder with remembered permissions receive those permissions.

ShowMarker.Name: Show folder marker
ShowMarker.Hint: Show a lock icon in the sidebar next to folders with remembered permissions (GM only).
